Name: Time Before Harvest Enhanced
Author: Enom
Description:
A simple mod that shows the remaining days until a given crop can be harvested. This is a recompiled version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5764]TimeBeforeHarvest [/url]which fixes the SMAPI error and incorrect times on crops that regrow.

The default keybinding is [font=Courier New]F2[/font] but that can be changed in the [b][font=Courier New]config.json[/font][/b] found in the [i]TimeBeforeHarvestEnhanced[/i] mod folder. You can find the button code values for the [font=Courier New][b]TriggerButton [/b][/font]here: [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Key_Bindings]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Key_Bindings[/url]

The project repository is open source and hosted on GitLab: [url=https://gitlab.com/enom/time-before-harvest-enhanced]https://gitlab.com/enom/time-before-harvest-enhanced[/url]
